# PopupLoom

> Free website popup builder with 45 templates, a visual editor, hosted widget configuration and lead capture.

## Public product information
- [Overview and FAQ](https://popuploom.com/): features, account requirements, supported triggers and limitations.
- [Template catalog](https://popuploom.com/templates.html): all 45 starting designs grouped by purpose.
- [Installation guide](https://popuploom.com/guides/install-popups.html): installation, platform constraints and troubleshooting.
- [Guides hub](https://popuploom.com/guides/index.html): all original installation, lead and troubleshooting guides.
- [WordPress guide](https://popuploom.com/guides/wordpress-popup.html), [Shopify guide](https://popuploom.com/guides/shopify-popup.html), [Webflow guide](https://popuploom.com/guides/webflow-popup.html): platform-specific placement and caveats.
- [Collect and export leads](https://popuploom.com/guides/collect-and-export-leads.html): lead inbox, CSV, browser and server webhooks.
- [Popup not showing](https://popuploom.com/guides/popup-not-showing.html): diagnostic sequence for saved widgets.
- [Ecommerce popup guide](https://popuploom.com/guides/popup-builder-for-ecommerce.html): free playbook for first-order offers, cart rescue, free-shipping bars, back-in-stock and review requests.
- [Quick-commerce popup guide](https://popuploom.com/guides/popup-builder-for-quick-commerce.html): serviceability, launch, app-install and reorder popups for hyperlocal storefronts.
- [Lead-generation popup guide](https://popuploom.com/guides/popup-builder-for-lead-generation.html): lead magnets, webinars, waitlists, forms, CSV export and webhooks.
- [About PopupLoom](https://popuploom.com/about.html): who operates the product and how templates should be understood.
- [Contact](https://popuploom.com/contact.html): support, privacy, security and blocklist questions.
- [Terms of use](https://popuploom.com/terms.html): accounts, acceptable use, lead data and liability.
- [Full documentation](https://popuploom.com/llms-full.txt): extended machine-readable product documentation with the builder facts, embed format, limits and FAQ.

## Product facts
- Guest users can design and preview. An account and saved widget are required for hosted install code.
- Supported automatic triggers: page load, delay, scroll depth, scroll to element, click and desktop exit intent. Choose one per widget.
- Custom HTML/JavaScript support is required on the destination website. Iframe embeds cannot escape their frame.
- Captured responses are associated with the owner's saved widget; API and account data are not public documentation.
- No conversion outcome or search ranking is guaranteed.
